reviewer: Codex coordinator /root, separate from the image producers. All 36 selected final WebPs were viewed at exercise-display scale; the umbrella, coat, books, cup, paper flower, dog chair and apple were also inspected enlarged. This is an AI visual/editorial review, with user taste approval pending.
style: Original repository minimal flat style and original 070 composition suffix, used verbatim; scene/cast facts from the final independently reviewed source. References were used for visual QA only.
